tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards and the main column. Body text `ink` reads 10:1 (light) and 14.7:1 (dark) on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the sticky header, menus, drawers, modals and toasts.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Table header rows, row hover, input-group addons, the inactive part of a card footer.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, icon squares on stat tiles, neutral badge ground, skeleton blocks. `ink-muted` reads 4.5:1 (light) and 6:1 (dark) on it.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline around cards, tables, menus and the header's bottom edge. Decorative separation only; it carries no meaning.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Row dividers and card-footer rules inside a card.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Default (white) button outline and the card-link hover edge. The button's label identifies it, so this edge may sit below 3:1.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs, selects, text areas, checkboxes, radios and switches: 3.26:1 on `surface` (light) and 3.56:1 (dark), so the control's shape is visible without its label.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Page titles, card titles, stat-tile figures and table cell emphasis on `surface` and `canvas`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on every surface: 10:1 or better in light, 11.5:1 or better in dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions, placeholders, axis ticks and legends: 4.5:1 or better on `surface`, `canvas`, `surface-subtle` and `surface-muted` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Decorative icons beside a text label, disabled text and empty-chart hints. Never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: 1880 charcoal. The one primary button per view, checked controls, the active tab underline, the emphasized chart series. In dark it flips to near-white so it still leads.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `primary` fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` fills: 16:1 light, 14.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a 2px ring outside a 2px `surface` gap. 14:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: The charcoal sidebar: the 1880 mark in white, navigation and section labels.

tokens.name: sidebar-ink
tokens.usage: Sidebar link text and icons at rest: 6.7:1 on `sidebar` (light) and 7.5:1 (dark).

tokens.name: sidebar-ink-active
tokens.usage: The current sidebar link and hovered links.

tokens.name: sidebar-active
tokens.usage: Pill behind the current sidebar link.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Right edge of the sidebar; visible only in dark, where it separates the sidebar from `canvas`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Fill for success bars, dots, rails and badges' dots: done, on track, approved, connected. Pair it with a word or icon; it is not a text color. In light it sits below 3:1 on `surface` (2.4 to 2.8:1), so a word or icon always travels with it; in dark it clears 3:1.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind success badges, alerts and stat-tile icon squares.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success text, badge labels, delta pills and alert titles on `surface` and on `success-soft`: 5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around success badges and alerts.
